Rent Potential & Upside

Multiple Income Strategies

Long-Term Rental

Market rent of $1,500/mo with likely under-market upside and utility bill-back potential.

Rent-By-Room

Three-room potential at an estimated $1,200–$1,500/mo combined, supported by demand near Fountain Square, downtown employers, and hospitals.

Short-Term Rental

Est. $90–$120/night at 55–65% occupancy ($1,500–$2,000+/mo projected). STR viability requires zoning confirmation for the Near Southeast area.

Subsidized Program Fit

Section 8 FMR for a 3BR in the Indianapolis metro is approximately $1,900. Property may also qualify for VASH, RRH, BRRH, or group-home / sober-living use, supported by nearby hospitals, shelters, reentry programs, and downtown workforce demand.

Location & Demand Drivers

Near Southeast Indianapolis

Positioned in a stabilizing, high-demand rental corridor south of downtown with strong access to employment, healthcare, and transit.

Demand Drivers

  • Major employers: Eli Lilly, Elevance Health, Cummins, and state government — all downtown core
  • Hospitals: Eskenazi Health, IU Health / Riley area (short drive)
  • Colleges: IUPUI and downtown campuses
  • Parks & trails: Garfield Park, Indianapolis Cultural Trail access
  • Entertainment: Fountain Square and Mass Ave corridors
  • Transit: Strong IndyGo bus coverage
  • Redevelopment: Near Southeast revitalization zone
